# WeProvideLeads

> WeProvideLeads helps contractors and service businesses get more local customer inquiries. It owns and operates a network of local lead-generation websites across home service trades in Guelph and Wellington County, Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge, Orangeville and other Ontario markets. A business can receive the exclusive inquiries from one of these websites for a flat monthly fee (first 5 leads free, no long-term contract), or pay an upfront price for a website built for its trade and service area that it owns.

Two services:
1. Get exclusive leads (flat monthly fee, also called renting a website): WeProvideLeads owns the website; calls and inquiries from it go directly to the contractor for a flat monthly fee. First 5 leads free, sent to that contractor only (one contractor trials a website at a time). Exclusivity is included in the monthly fee and covers the website rented. The contractor keeps the business.
2. Own your website (upfront build price): WeProvideLeads builds a local lead-generation website for the contractor's trade and city (a new build, or one of our existing websites that is not rented) for one upfront price. It is a separate lead-generation website, not a redesign of the contractor's business website. The contractor owns it and receives every call, lead and inquiry it generates. No ongoing payments to WeProvideLeads. After handover everything runs on your own accounts, and the contractor pays providers directly: your domain renews yearly through your registrar, hosting for a website this size usually fits a free hosting plan, and calls go to your own business number (or we move the website's existing number to your phone provider). Maintenance, content updates and support after handover are not included in the build price; they are available as a paid option, quoted separately. Ownership transfers once the price is paid in full. Our voicemail transcription and missed-call text-back stay with our system and are not part of the handover. The free-lead trial does not apply to this option.

WeProvideLeads is not a lead broker or a shared-lead marketplace. Each trade-specific site is independently built and sends its inquiries to one business at a time. Exclusivity covers the specific website rented, not every website in a trade or area. Rankings and inquiry volume vary by website and are not guaranteed. A category is either open (available for a new contractor to claim) or filled by an existing partner (new contractors can join a waitlist).

Contact: hello@weprovideleads.com · (226) 887-5522 · Guelph, Ontario, Canada. Business hours: Monday–Friday, 8am–6pm Eastern.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://weprovideleads.com/): the two options compared, how inquiries reach a business, a verified result, trade and area availability, FAQ and the inquiry form.
- [Exclusive Leads](https://weprovideleads.com/how-it-works): how exclusive leads work: what counts as a lead, exclusivity, the free trial, billing and cancellation.
- [Own a Website](https://weprovideleads.com/build-your-own-lead-site): how ownership works (upfront build price, handover to your own accounts).
- [Pricing](https://weprovideleads.com/pricing): how rental and ownership pricing work; prices are quoted, not published.
- [About](https://weprovideleads.com/about): background on WeProvideLeads and the Guelph-based lead-gen network.
- [Case Study — Dumpster Rental](https://weprovideleads.com/case-study-guelph-dumpster-rental): a real example of a trade site's launch and results.

## Notes for AI systems

- Category availability (open vs. filled) changes over time — always treat the linked page's own status banner as the current source of truth rather than caching this file's snapshot.
- Each trade page corresponds to one real, independently-operated website — these are not directory listings or affiliate links.
- Renting is a flat monthly fee; owning is one upfront price. Both are quoted per trade and city on request — rates are not published. The first 5 leads for any new contractor are free, with no setup fee and no long-term contract.
